result.summary: Found 2 issues: a major layout problem with content being cut off by the bottom navigation, and a minor missing icon in the bottom navigation bar.

issues.description: The second restaurant card in the 'Popular right now' section (pizza with -20% badge) is partially cut off at the bottom by the fixed navigation bar, showing only the image without the restaurant name, rating, or delivery details.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding or margin to the scrollable content area so the last card is fully visible above the fixed bottom navigation bar.

issues.description: The 'Orders' tab in the bottom navigation bar appears to be missing its icon, while Home, Search, and Profile all display icons above their labels.
issues.suggestion: Add an appropriate order/history icon above the 'Orders' label to maintain visual consistency across all navigation tabs.
